en.headline: Local businesses whose IT needs are changing
en.subheadline: Each week we flag companies near you that are newly registered, growing or looking for IT staff – with the date and the source.

signals.title: New companies
signals.text: A new company sets up email, devices and security in its first months.

signals.title: Hiring for IT roles
signals.text: An open IT support role can be a reason to offer managed support instead.

signals.title: Official source
signals.text: Every lead shows where it comes from.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: From official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.
No. Each lead contains company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How often do I receive leads?
faq.a: Every Monday as a spreadsheet, filtered to your areas and signals. Each lead is delivered to you only once.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from your area, with the same fields as the regular delivery. No obligation.
